description: This file defines internal data structures and functions for reporting test results in JSON format within the Ginkgo testing framework. It includes types for events, reports, and spec reports, as well as functions for converting test states and creating test names.

classes.name: gojsonEvent
classes.description: Represents a test event in JSON format, matching Go internals.

classes.name: gojsonReport
classes.description: Wraps types.Report and adds fields for Go package and elapsed time.

classes.name: gojsonSpecReport
classes.description: Wraps types.SpecReport and adds fields for test name, elapsed time, and action.

methods.name: ptr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the input value.

methods.name: goJSONActionFromSpecState
methods.description: Converts a SpecState to a corresponding GoJSONAction.

methods.name: newReport
methods.description: Creates a new gojsonReport from a types.Report.

methods.name: Fill
methods.description: Populates additional fields in gojsonReport based on the suite path.

methods.name: newSpecReport
methods.description: Creates a new gojsonSpecReport from a types.SpecReport.

methods.name: Fill
methods.description: Populates additional fields in gojsonSpecReport, including test name and action.

methods.name: suitePathToPkg
methods.description: Converts a directory path to a Go package ID.

methods.name: createTestName
methods.description: Generates a descriptive test name based on SpecReport details.

methods.name: formatComponentSemVerConstraintsToString
methods.description: Formats component semantic version constraints into a string.
